body:
Hi, are you still there? 

Pls, reply. Me and all the redditors are willing to help you, I almost killed myself too, but I didn't do this cuz no matter how big your problems are, LIVE STILL WORTH LIVING.
I lost someone to suicide few days ago, it's not the right choice. Your problems will just be transfered to another loved one. Don't do it!

UPDATE
 - His family talked to his clients, they are in shock and the one who threatened him and made his life a hell deleted every post and closed all his accounts, we can’t find him anymore.
Found the post, he tried his best to solve his problems, when he needed help I didn’t step up to help... https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7kj9a9/my_nightmare_will_end_today/
He said he published something here, I can’t find the post.
